cohort: 495 women admitted to a birth center in Ontario, Canada, matched on a 1:4 basis with similar low-risk midwifery clients giving birth in a hospital
finding: In the first year of operation of two stand-alone midwifery-led birth centers in Ontario, Canada, rates of intervention were significantly lower among women who planned birth center births compared with those who planned hospital births, even after controlling for previous cesarean birth and body mass index.
